//! Every spelling renamed, consistently, to a name that is also wrong.

pub struct MetricsParams {
    /// The resolution, in whole minutes.
    pub step_x: i64,
}

pub const MAX_EX_PER_FRAME: u32 = 100;
pub const DEFAULT_EX_PER_FRAME: u32 = 100;

pub fn axis_points(width: i64, step_x: i64) -> i64 {
    width / step_x
}
